reviews.text:
Dear team

Please update your app at the least like al quran app which allows you to tap on words and play the specific part to pronounce. Plus there could be a lot of inclusions in the app of various scripts of quran e majeed. I am your paid customer

reviews.title: Non stop requests to rate the app

reviews.text: We need it in different languages

reviews.text: If each time I open app and I am asked to write review then for me it’s a worst app.

reviews.title: Unable to contact support, use the app
reviews.text: I have recently switched from iOS to android. Purchased the full version while on iOS, yet can’t log in on my android with the email used to purchased the full version and enjoy it on android. I transferred all other purchases of other apps that one won’t work. On top of that the support page is poor and do not work. I need a fix here thanks

reviews.title: Why make this money?
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for years and it’s been great. There were plenty of sheikhs to listen to. But now I can only read baqara and Fatiha. Everything else is money. Why would you ruin such a good Quran app? Please remove this feature it is very horrible.

reviews.title: Classic reciters voice glitch
reviews.text:
I have noticed there’s issue in classic reciters like sheikh Abdul Basit and  sheikh Minshawi ,there recitations seems from old recordings or maybe tempered which sounds different from the ones widely available and more pleasing. Qari waheed zafar qasmi’s recitation has tajweed errors  too.
Additionally, I would like to request you kindly add qari syed sadaqt Ali into reciters he has beautiful tajweed and voice.

reviews.title: Great before popups
reviews.text: Was great until the “write a review” pop up started happening everyday. And another thing. I used to be able to play and pause from my phones control panel. But it seems the apps update removed that.
